notes: The cataloguer noted: 'A sentence follows which I do not understand: thva sarasvati deva yā śiro kathavagvastikadhani karmmā cājye yo kekāyāva devyandrakarmmā cājyena thava āṣalasena vavamacātośene yātāhleyājulo śubha ||'. Devendra Karmācārya (Devyandra Karmācājya) is clearly named as the scribe (Newari: 'thava āṣalasena' = in his own hand/letters). Other possible names or kin relations mentioned in this corrupt Newari clause (e.g. 'sarasvati deva', 'karmmā cājye yo kekāyāva') remain uncertain.
